title: A Landfall for the Horizon
author: Dominic Hartwell
blurb: Rosalind Marchetti, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
